purpose: Teach: ひっかかっ/手ごろ/めでたし/微塵/多けれ/ともども/気長/なめらか

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの服が枝にひっかかっちゃったのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's clothes got caught on a branch.
lines.style: Light, wry observation — the kind a mother makes when she's seen similar small mishaps before. Dry humor underneath, not unkind. Matter-of-fact pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんが「これは手ごろな値段だ」って仰ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa said this one was reasonably priced.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact statement. A small observation delivered without fanfare. Sho's typical tone — noticing something adults might miss, saying it plainly without seeking approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本のお話、「めでたしめでたし」で終わるのよ
lines.en: Sho, but storybooks end with 'happily ever after,' don't they.
lines.style: Gentle, patient redirect — the tone of a mother gently steering toward a softer ending. Not scolding. Warm, almost wistful. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに怒られても微塵も後悔してないよ
lines.en: Mom, even if Dad gets upset with me, I don't regret it one bit.
lines.style: Steady, quiet certainty. No defensiveness — just straightforward conviction. The kind of honest statement a child makes when he's thought about it and meant it. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達が多ければ多いほど嬉しいわね
lines.en: Mom, the more friends you have, the happier you feel, don't you.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. Not quite a question — more like she's thinking aloud, offering something she's come to believe. Warm, settled tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんとともども元気で過ごしたいね
lines.en: Mom, I want to keep living healthily alongside Grandpa.
lines.style: Soft, sincere wish stated plainly. No drama — just honest tenderness. The voice of a child who knows what matters. Slight tender trailing-off.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ピアノは気長に練習すれば上達するわよ
lines.en: Sho, piano will improve if you practice patiently over time.
lines.style: Encouraging, steady wisdom from a mother who knows encouragement works. Not pushing — offering. Warm, confident in the path ahead. Unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ピアノがなめらかに弾けるようになったよ
lines.en: Mom, I can play the piano smoothly now.
lines.style: Quiet pride. The small, genuine satisfaction of someone who worked and succeeded. No boasting — just pleased with the fact itself. Soft, sincere close.
